details.boundaryOrTradeoff: The nearest alternative is leave the response stream open after denial so another territory can inspect it. It can seem convenient for retry or reuse, but the prompt names which operation still owns the resource and when that operation ends.
details.transfer: Separate durable domain state from temporary resources. Keep each temporary resource within the operation that acquired it, release on success/failure/cancel, and transfer ownership only at an explicit successful handoff.
